subject: Important Information Regarding Your Recent Flight Booking
body: Dear valued customer, We would like to inform you that there has been a change in your upcoming flight itinerary. Due to unforeseen circumstances, your departure time has been rescheduled to 2 hours earlier. Please review your updated itinerary attached to this email. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Should you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to our customer service team. Thank you for choosing our airline for your travel needs.
